toolDefect.site: host.mjs:99 stopApi stop proof requires the systemd Job property to read exactly 0
toolDefect.realBehavior: systemctl show -p Job prints Job= with an empty value when the unit has no job (systemd source: systemctl.c sets BUS_PRINT_PROPERTY_SHOW_EMPTY for -p; systemctl-show.c passes NULL for job id 0; bus-print-properties.c prints Name=). No systemd version prints Job=0.
toolDefect.impact: Every API stop proof would time out and report STOP_FAILED after the API had already stopped: m1 step 4 (host.mjs:881), apiOff (host.mjs:709, reached from m4aMain and xmMain) and xm step 0 (host.mjs:1086). This is the EM-1 class of failure: an API outage after effects, with no automatic restart.
toolDefect.origin: The measurement-v2 correction tightened the earlier check that accepted an empty or 0 Job; the correction fixtures served Job 0, so their tests could not see it. host.mjs:165 still accepts empty but also accepts a missing Job line.
toolDefect.verification: Confirmed by the independent Opus audit from systemd source. Not yet observed on the VPS; a read-only host read of one raw Job line is still needed.
toolDefect.harnessEffect: With the real Job shape, H-7b and H-7d FAIL with TOOL_DEFECT_STOPAPI_JOB_EMPTY. A diagnostic run with Job 0 shows the rest of each path passes; it can never turn a FAIL into a PASS. H-7c does not stop the API and passes.
toolDefect.proposedFix: In a new tool version, accept exactly an empty Job value (or empty or 0) at host.mjs:99 and host.mjs:165, refuse a missing Job line, move the correction fixtures to the real shape, add a regression that parses a literal Job= line through parseShowText into stopApi for inactive and failed units, and re-accept the tool before any epoch.

em1RootCauseProof.toolSide: The accepted tool checks the enabled API configuration in m0 and in the m1 pre-gate; an enroll layer without the storage limits file and dataset root stops with ENABLED_CONFIG_SCHEMA and zero effects.
em1RootCauseProof.productSide: The eb532ff product readers QuantDataService (quant-data.js:48) and QuantResearchService (quant-research.js:43), loaded from the pinned export in an isolated worker thread, accept the API prospective environment the tool would write. Without QUANT_STORAGE_LIMITS_FILE they refuse with QUANT_STORAGE_LIMITS_REQUIRED (the EM-1 error); without only the dataset root they refuse with STORAGE_BUDGET_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED.
em1RootCauseProof.unproven: createQuantPreflightApi needs a database after its environment gates and is unproven until real PostgreSQL.

Every simulation override is honored only when the run is marked injected; passing paths assert verdict, null code and no blockers.

reviews.architectureAudit: ACCEPT_WITH_FIXES; harness fixes applied; tool defect confirmed
reviews.independentTester: PASS_WITH_FINDINGS twice; second pass 36 of 36 with only low or info findings

residualFindings: The H-15 expected holdout fact uses the new boundary and ignores a lower existing minimum; the drift run still fails closed, but the message can mislead.

The product-config worker imports readers from the plan product root while the pin check uses the tool root; they are the same path in the suite, and a tampered copy is refused, but a mismatched-root case is unprobed.

The fake systemd clears InvocationID on stop, sets NeedDaemonReload on pending-file creation, fixes the other-units reload count at 0, leaves ExecStart and EnvironmentFiles empty, and models neither start-limit-hit nor a queued job id.
limitations: No PostgreSQL ran: SQL semantics, triggers, constraints, the holdout write-once row, the users.status and pine_deployments.state drift writes, and the pool and process peaks are unproven.
